name: Die gute Luise
kurzbeschreibung:
**The Good Luise in Gerlos** – A cozy mountain inn in the heart of the **Zillertal Alps**, where hearty **Tiroler** hospitality meets rustic charm. Enjoy traditional dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Gröstl**, and **Käsespätzle**, paired with local **Tiroler** beers and fine wines. The perfect retreat after a day of hiking, skiing, or simply soaking in the breathtaking views of the **Gerlostal Valley**.

<iframe src="https://www.google.com/maps/embed?pb=..." width="600" height="450" style="border:0;" allowfullscreen="" loading="lazy"></iframe>

**Location:** Gerlos 123, 6292 Gerlos, **Tirol**
**Open:** Daily from 11:00 AM – 10:00 PM (seasonal variations may apply)
**Specialties:** Homemade **Apfelstrudel**, **Tiroler Gröstl**, and fresh mountain trout.
**Highlights:** Wood-fired oven, panoramic terrace, and a warm, family-run atmosphere. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck** and the **Zillertal Arena**.
